references.text: The priest shall wave the offering as a wave offering before the Lord, parallel to the wave offering in the Nazirite vow.
Describes the wave offering of the breast and the heave offering of the thigh belonging to the priest, the same parts mentioned in Num 6:20.
Moses placed the offerings into the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them as a wave offering before the Lord.
The wave breast and the heave thigh shall be eaten in a clean place; they belong to the priest as his portion.
The wave breast and the heave thigh from the consecration ram belong to the priest, a holy gift to the Lord.
The preceding context concerns the Nazirite's offerings and cleansing before he may drink wine again.
The wave offering belongs to the priest and his family as a holy gift.
The priest shall wave the loaves together with the firstfruits offering as a wave offering for the Lord, holy to the priest.
